question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.5.
solution:
The correct answer is **amazing**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Amazing"** means "**charming**" or "**wonderful**", something which amazes us or charms us with its beauty.
 
• Therefore, the complete sentence is. ".**..falls create an amazing spectacle."​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word "**different" **means "**not same".**

 
 
• **Example-** *He has a different attitude towards education than his father*.
 
 
 
• "**Peculiar"** means "**strange"**, **something which is not normal**.
 
 
• **Example- ***Yesterday, he behaved in a peculiar manner with me in the office as if he didn’t know me***.**
 
 
 
• **"Fantastic"** means something which is **extraordinary**. It always carries **a sense of imaginativeness and fantasy**.
 
 
• **Example-** *Blood and Guts is a fantastic art work of literature done by Kathy Acker.*
